# fortisase_infra_data_transfer (Data Source)

Get data transfer usage information.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fortisase_infra_data_transfer" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `annual_allotment` (Number) Number of bytes of data transfer allotted to the tenant annually.
- `consumed_bytes` (Number) Number of bytes the tenant has consumed since licenseStart.
- `consumed_percent` (Number) Percent of annualAllotment that the tenant has consumed.
- `license_start` (Number) Most recent anniversary of the tenant's license start time as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
- `remaining_allotment` (Number) Number of bytes remaining in the tenant's annual data transfer allotment.
- `snapshot_end_ms` (Number) Date up to which usage is calculated (exclusive of that date) as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant ID
